prompt:
Rewrite snippets/address-block-2.liquid so it renders a postal address plus an optional distance and walking-time line. Use integer arithmetic only; no floats. INPUTS (all top-level; no section.settings): - `address`: object, never null. All five keys are always present: - `address.name`: string or null - `address.line1`: string, never null - `address.line2`: string or null - `address.postal_code`: string or null - `address.city`: string, never null - `distance_m`: non-negative integer (meters) or null. 0 is a valid distance. A string value is "present" when it is not null and not exactly the empty string "". Do not strip whitespace. HTML-escape every address text value with the standard escape (& < > " '). OUTPUT Emit one line with no whitespace or newlines between tags. The parts appear in this order inside `
` ... `
`: 1. If name is present: `NAME`. 2. Always: `LINE1`. 3. If line2 is present: `LINE2`. 4. Always: `CITY`. If postal_code is present, the content is instead `POSTAL CITY`, with exactly one space between them. 5. If distance_m is not null: `DIST, WALK walk`. DIST is chosen by testing the raw distance_m value: - distance_m < 1000: round to the nearest multiple of 10, with halves rounding up, and print ` m`. Examples: 994 gives "990 m" and 995 gives "1000 m". The test uses the raw value, not the rounded one. - distance_m >= 1000: round to the nearest tenth of a kilometre, with halves rounding up, and print `. km`. Always print exactly one decimal digit. Examples: 1000 gives "1.0 km", 1249 gives "1.2 km", 1250 gives "1.3 km". WALK: - Compute minutes = ceiling(distance_m / 80), with a minimum of 1. - If minutes < 60: ` min`. - Otherwise let H = minutes integer-divided by 60 and M = the remainder. - If M is 0: ` h`. - Otherwise: ` h min`. When distance_m is null, the distance span is omitted entirely. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/address-block-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
